Players Committee card image of [[BoShek, Gritty Smuggler]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. BoShek's deploy cost may not be increased. During battle, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny or cancel an attempt to cancel and redraw a destiny. Immune to attrition < 3.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/boshek.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/boshek.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
